features: Monitor the inside of your home day and night with our 1080P HD indoor plug-in smart security camera with motion detection and two-way audio.

sections.title: Wyze Cam V3
content: La Wyze Cam V3 es una cámara de seguridad que ofrece detección de movimiento y sonido, con grabación continua 24/7. Su diseño resistente al agua permite instalarla tanto en interiores como exteriores, y su visión nocturna en color la hace ideal para cualquier entorno.
Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los 37 dólares. ¡Link en el primer comentario!
features: Motion & Sound Detection: Wyze Cam sends an alert to your phone when baby is crying. 24/7 Continuous video recording with a Wyze micro SD card (sold separately) lets you monitor your home security throughout the night easily.
Indoor/Outdoor: Wyze Cam v3 is a wired video camera with an IP65 rating so you can confidently install it outside in the rain or inside in the baby room. (Only work with 2.4GHz WiFi)
2-Way Talk: Wyze Cam now comes with simultaneous 2-way communication. Let your baby hear the sound of your voice no matter where you are.

Color Night Vision: An all-new Starlight Sensor records night time video in full, vivid color. The Starlight Sensor can see full color in environments up to 25x darker than traditional video cameras and the new f/1.6 aperture captures 2x more light.

Works with Alexa and Google Assistant: Use your voice to view Wyze Cam's live stream on any Alexa or Google Assistant device with a screen. You can say things like “Alexa, show me the living room” or “Ok Google, show the baby' room.”

Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los 45 dólares. ¡Link en el primer comentario!
features: Standard version of CIC invisible earpiece, battery life about 8 hours, compared to other brands of earpiece, it has longer time.
Include 3.5-3.5mm adapter, 35 inchs long fine cable with external MIC and clip, compatible with Android phones, tablets, Kindle, eReaders, etc

Disclaimer: You must use a certified SR416SW battery to ensure sufficient battery capacity. If you use poor battery, we do not guarantee continuous working time for more than 8 hours.

sections.title: Vandlion Voice Recorder
content: El Vandlion Voice Recorder permite grabar con alta calidad gracias a su reducción de ruido. Con un simple botón puedes iniciar o detener la grabación. Su función activada por voz ahorra tiempo de grabación y su reproducción fácil lo hace muy práctico.
Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los 50 dólares. ¡Link en el primer comentario!
features: 【Simple Operation】- switch on your voice recorder, one button for recording. press the "REC", start the recording, press "STOP", end the recording, press “PLAY”, listen what you just recorded, and then Press A-B, select your important section to repeat. Easy to playback with inner powerful speaker, support external sound speaker playback, let you enjoy superior recording quality.

【Clear Voice Record】- high quality recording with noise redution, you will get super clear recorded voice, the sensitive microphone help you to catch speaker's words in an interview, lectures, meetings.
【Voice Activated Recording】- automatic voice reduction function, it starts recording when sound is detected or turn to standby state, saving recording time and reduce power consumption.

【 Player Function】- this voice recorder can be used as an music player, you could enjoy the music after your tired study, meeting and so on. Also can function as a detachable data storage device.you can take along your favorite pictures and documents whenever you go.Simply cut-and-paste or drag-and -drop files to or from it via USB connection, the player will appear as a removeable drive in Windows.

【High quality and long time】 uses DSP noise reduction technology to filter out environmental noise, has high-quality recording, 【1536kbps】to restore the real scene. It can continuously record for more than 30 hours and play for 7 hours.

sections.title: Arcshell UHF Radio
content: 'La Arcshell UHF Radio ofrece operación manos libres gracias a su sistema VOX, ideal para actividades al aire libre como ciclismo o senderismo. Con radios recargables y un auricular incluido, es perfecta para profesionales y aventureros.
features: Hands-Free Freedom: Say goodbye to button pressing and Unleash the Power of Multi-Tasking with VOX (Voice Activated Operation). VOX allows you to work, play, or engage in any activity while staying connected. Whether you're climbing mountains, bicycling, motorcycling, organizing events, or coordinating projects, VOX lets you communicate without missing a beat

Professional radio in various situation, such as construction sites between contractors, supervisors, and workers; manufacturing plants, industrial hall, warehouse, transportation adn logistics industry, hotel staff, event planners, restaurant teams, and security personnel, retail stores, concerts, conferences, trade shows, sporting events, hospitals, healthcare centers, education institutions, hikers, campers, airsoft, bicycling, motorcycling, film and TV production, stage, and photography

Rechargeable walkie-talkies: Save money in the long run with rechargeable walkie-talkies. No more purchasing disposable batteries that drain your wallet. Simply recharge your devices and keep them ready for action. You can charge your walkie walkies with our charging base or with the USB Type-C port on the walkie talkies. It lasts around 8 to 96 hours on a single charge depending on how much you transmit

Earpiece with mic included: each radio comes with a single-earbud style earpiece(foam piece included). The earpiece has its own built-in microphone and a Push-to-Talk button; earpiece plug is K-type of 3.5mm plug and 2.5mm plug;when you plug in the earpiece,all sound goes to the earpiece and the radio speaker is silent

Ready to use right out of the box: simply turn them on and start communicating without the need for any additional programming or configuration; user-friendly and easy to operate for all ages. Push-to-Talk button is on the left side of the radio; built-in mic and built-in speaker are on the front of the radio. Loud an crystal-clear sound quality with noise cancelling feature by adjusting the squelch level
